New Grad Physical Therapy (NGPT) is built upon the foundation of interesting people doing great work.  New graduates and young professionals are the future, and we must cultivate the growth of our generation. Helping each other means improving the care that we provide our patients.

We understand that a career in healthcare is a sacrifice and the people who sacrifice deserve a community of peers who care. We believe that coming together as a community to make each other better is paramounts to both growth as a profession, and as individuals.
